query:
SELECT 
  a.id,
  a.claim_id,
  LEFT(a.cost_intelligence_json, 800) as cost_intel,
  LEFT(a.enforcement_json, 400) as enforcement_preview
FROM ai_assessments a
ORDER BY a.id DESC
LIMIT 2;
